# Metadata for data://garden/democracy/2026-11-04/proxies (schema/metadata.schema.yml)
title: Health-of-democracy proxies, GDELT phrase timelines and Rooney Report toplines, as of 2026-11-04
description: >-
  Two kinds of proxy for "health of democracy". GDELT timelines measure
  attention: the share of monitored online news (DOC 2.0) and of national TV
  caption airtime (TV 2.0) that contains a phrase, including Anthropic
  co-mention queries. Rooney toplines are stated attitudes: percents of US
  respondents printed in the text of the Notre Dame Health of Democracy Survey's
  Rooney Reports, each checked against the pinned PDF. None of these series
  measures any effect of Anthropic on democracy. Method and limits in
  docs/democracy-proxies.md.
processing: >-
  `build` reads only saved bytes (no network) and fails if any saved file's
  size, SHA-256 or BLAKE3 differs from MANIFEST.tsv. GDELT: for each of the 24
  planned requests, every timeline point becomes one row of gdelt-timelines.tsv
  (date truncated to YYYYMMDD; value formatted to at most 6 decimals) and each
  series one row of gdelt-summary.tsv; a request never received is kept as a
  NOT PINNED summary row, not dropped, and a `{}` response (no matching clip)
  as an empty-series row. DOC timelinevolraw rows would carry a "(norm)"
  series (GDELT's daily total), but none were pinned. Rooney: each pinned
  report PDF is re-extracted page by page with pypdf 5.4.0 and normalised (NFKC,
  curly quotes, dashes, soft hyphens, whitespace); rooney-reports.tsv records
  page and embedded-image counts and any "AI transparency statement".
  Each hand-transcribed row is checked: the quote must be on its stated page,
  value_text in the quote, and percent in the quote; each hand-copied stem must
  occur in its pinned questionnaire. Any failure stops the build, so the
  toplines and items hold every input row. Drops: chart images (counted, never
  read or estimated), GDELT article and clip text (never requested; no artlist
  mode), and the 7 GDELT requests that returned HTTP 429 (no data, reported as
  NOT PINNED).
unit_of_analysis: >-
  gdelt-timelines.tsv: one (source, query, mode, series, period) value;
  gdelt-summary.tsv: one planned GDELT request and series; rooney-reports.tsv:
  one Rooney Report; rooney-toplines.tsv: one percent printed in report text;
  rooney-items.tsv: one questionnaire item stem.
denominator: >-
  corpus/democracy/gdelt-summary.tsv (all 24 planned GDELT requests, 7 marked
  NOT PINNED); corpus/democracy/rooney-reports.tsv (all 13 reports linked from
  the pinned listing page); corpus/democracy/rooney-transcription.tsv and
  corpus/democracy/rooney-questionnaire.tsv for toplines and items (every input
  row passes or the build fails).
coverage: >-
  GDELT DOC 2.0: daily, 2017-01-01 to 2026-11-03, 3,547 days returned per
  pinned query (days missing from GDELT's response are absent, not zero); 5 of
  12 DOC requests pinned, none of them raw counts, so no DOC article counts or
  daily totals. GDELT TV 2.0: monthly, 2009-07 to 2024-10, 184 months,
  national stations combined; all 12 requests pinned; nothing after October
  2024 is returned. Rooney: 13 reports, October 2024 to May 2026, 129 printed
  values (text layer only; chart figures not extracted); 30 questionnaire stems
  (29 October 2025, 1 May 2026). Earlier waves' questionnaires were not pinned.
  As of 2026-11-04.
does_not_answer:
  - "Whether democracy is healthy: attention is not health. More articles saying \"health of democracy\" can mean more threat, more advocacy, or one viral op-ed. These series count words."
  - "Democratic conditions: Rooney measures what respondents say about norms, not institutions, elections or rights. Stated attitudes are not conditions."
  - "Anything about Anthropic specifically: no series isolates Anthropic. A co-mention count cannot tell praise from criticism, or Anthropic's work on democracy from a reporter's list of AI companies."
  - "Public attitudes to AI or technology companies: Rooney asks nothing about them. Neither pinned questionnaire mentions artificial intelligence, and no pinned report prints the May 2026 DEMOPROB result (the only technology option, \"Social media and misinformation\")."
  - "Causality: even a perfect Anthropic-specific series would show association with attention, not an effect on democratic health."
license:
  name: >-
    Per table: gdelt-*.tsv derive from GDELT data (GDELT terms of use: free use,
    citation and link required); rooney-*.tsv carry short verbatim quotes
    (c) University of Notre Dame, no licence stated. Not CC0.
  url: null
  url_reason: >-
    unknown: GDELT's terms are at https://www.gdeltproject.org/about.html, but
    no licence is stated for the Rooney material or for this folder's derived
    tables (corpus/democracy/README.md). A licence statement from the
    repository owner and the Rooney Democracy Institute would settle it.
status: held

    description: "Every point of every pinned GDELT timeline. Sorted by source, query_id, mode, series, date."

    columns:

      "resolution":

**Gap count:** before, 3 (each of the three steps reported "no metadata file"). After, 0.

- New: `/Users/srvo/dev/anthropic-pbc/.claude/worktrees/agent-a53f660e8e83d59ce/corpus/democracy/responses_and_reports.meta.yml`
- New: `/Users/srvo/dev/anthropic-pbc/.claude/worktrees/agent-a53f660e8e83d59ce/corpus/democracy/rooney_transcription.meta.yml`
- New: `/Users/srvo/dev/anthropic-pbc/.claude/worktrees/agent-a53f660e8e83d59ce/corpus/democracy/proxies.meta.yml`

**Column checks**
- Every column of all 8 tables is documented, with type and description, and with unit where one applies. I compared each against the real file header myself: no column is missing or extra, and the order matches. That covers the snapshot tables too (MANIFEST, transcription, questionnaire), which the validator does not inspect.
- I checked every primary key for uniqueness against the 2026-11-04 files. The toplines and transcription tables have no natural single key. I used `[report, page, wave_as_stated, group, item, response, value_text]` and noted that the script does not enforce it.

**Snapshot metadata**
- The GDELT/Rooney snapshot has a `sources:` list with each producer's citation, URL, terms, licence and access date.
- I read the Rooney citation and the "© 2026 University of Notre Dame" footer from the saved survey and listing pages in `.democorpus/`.
- `personal_data` is `none` for all three steps. A note on the transcription explains that "Trump" appears only in voter-group labels.
- `does_not_answer` holds the five points of docs/democracy-proxies.md §4.

**Fields set to null (9, each with a `_reason`)**

responses_and_reports (5):
- `date_published`: there is no single date. GDELT responses are computed at request time, and the Rooney reports carry only the month the listing gives.
- `version_producer`: GDELT does not version API responses, and the Rooney PDFs carry no version.
- `license.url`: the Rooney pages state no licence. GDELT's terms URL is under `sources:`.
- `sources[rooney].license.url`: same cause.
- `sources[rooney].refetch`: nobody has tested whether re-downloading the Rooney asset URLs gives byte-identical PDFs. The GDELT source is `saved_bytes_are_pin` per the doc.

rooney_transcription (3):
- `url_main`: same unknown as the codebook example. Script user agents name github.com/ethicalcapital, but the remote is github.com/srvo.
- `url_download`: commit 7fcf0ef is on no remote branch.
- `license`: the README says the folder is not CC0 and names no licence for the transcription. The quotes are © Notre Dame.

proxies (1):
- `license.url`: no licence is stated for the Rooney material or for the folder's derived tables.

**Contradictions between code, docs and data (reported, not fixed)**
1. **"Stated conditions" vs "attitudes".** The script docstring calls the Rooney series "stated CONDITIONS", and the README intro says "as a stated condition". docs/democracy-proxies.md §4 says the opposite: "Stated attitudes are not conditions."
2. **User agent vs README licence.** The script's user agent says "public CC0 research repo", but the README says corpus/democracy/ is not covered by CC0.
3. **Report pages and images.** §3.2 says "Each report is two pages of prose around one to three chart images", and §3.3 says "1 to 3 per page". In rooney-reports.tsv, R01 has 1 page, and R06 and R10 page 2 have 0 images.
4. **Questionnaire items.** §3.2 says the October 2025 questionnaire lets rooney-questionnaire.tsv "map 30 report items". In fact, 29 rows are from October 2025 and 1 (DEMOPROB) is from May 2026. At least 2 of the 30 have no Rooney Report percent (DEMOPROB, and AUTODEMO C `democratic_system_good`, both per their notes), so they are not report items.
5. **AI disclosure wording.** §3.3 says the AI transparency statement "begins" with "...identification of trends" in all three reports. R09's text reads "identification/ summarization of trends".
6. **`response` column.** It exists in both rooney-transcription.tsv and rooney-toplines.tsv, but §3.2's column list omits it. `build` does not check it, and in 56 of 129 rows the label is not a word in the quote.
7. **Hand-entered columns.** The dag.yml comment says `build` "checks every quote and number against the page text". The code checks the quote against the page and value_text/percent against the quote. It does not check the hand-entered group, wave, item or response.

**Scratch files:** two helper scripts are in the scratchpad: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-srvo-dev-anthropic-pbc/c1e11076-829e-4b02-9641-6b48b095d475/scratchpad/cols.py` and `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-srvo-dev-anthropic-pbc/c1e11076-829e-4b02-9641-6b48b095d475/scratchpad/chk.py`. Nothing in the repo depends on them.
